Apple has spent years building an ecosystem that connects its devices, services, and software. Now, with Apple HomeView, the idea of bringing entertainment, communication, and smart home management together under one roof is an exciting concept for the future of connected living. [...] ## Final Takeaway

Apple HomeView represents an appealing vision of connected living: entertainment, communication, and smart home management working together in a more convenient way.

Apple already has many of the building blocks needed for this kind of experience, including Apple TV, the Home app, FaceTime, Siri, and a wide range of connected devices.

Whether HomeView becomes a standalone product, a new interface, or simply a concept will depend on verified information from Apple.

For consumers, the bigger question is how effectively Apple can make smart home technology feel less complicated and more natural. If a unified experience can deliver genuine convenience without sacrificing privacy or reliability, it could become a meaningful part of the connected home.

results.content:
CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today introduced Apple HomeView, designed to be central to the home and personal to everyone in it. With a stunning 7-inch Liquid Retina display, HomeView brings entertainment, connection, and smart home management together in one place, from playing music and making FaceTime calls to home monitoring and hands-free automations with voice control — all designed with privacy and security at the core.1 HomeView recognizes users by their faces, adapting so they can access their personal content in Messages, FaceTime, Calendar, Reminders, and Find My. HomeView features Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri that’s profoundly more capable and conversational, with broad world knowledge that powers richer music discovery and onscreen awareness. When paired with an [...] Connecting Users to What Matters Most

HomeView makes it effortless for users to stay in touch and get things done around the house. FaceTime and Center Stage keep everyone framed perfectly, even when participants are moving around the room.6 Messages can be read and answered by voice or with the onscreen keyboard. Intercom lets users broadcast a quick message to a single room or the whole house — reaching other HomeView and HomePod speakers, as well as personal devices like iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch. In the kitchen, HomeView is the perfect sous chef, converting recipes from the web into step-by-step instructions with hands-free timer control and help with ingredient tracking, so users can stay focused on what’s cooking. Apple’s new HomeView promises a 7-inch touchscreen, Siri AI (beta), FaceTime, and personalized controls that recognize household members. Starting at $299 in the U.S., it’s designed around Apple’s ecosystem, but households already using Alexa or Google Home may prefer something compatible with their existing devices. Apple says a full personalized experience requires an Apple Account, a compatible iPhone or iPad, and membership in the shared Home. Some personal-context Siri requests also require a paired Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad.

With HomeView scheduled to arrive on November 13, 2026, these three alternatives offer different ways to manage a connected home, from compact displays to family dashboards and portable tablets. [...] Skip to content

Managing a smart home shouldn’t require opening several apps to adjust the lights, check security cameras, or change the thermostat. A dedicated smart display puts those controls within reach, making connected devices easier for everyone in the household to use. [...] Amazon’s customizable interface makes the Echo Show 15 useful as a household information center. Mounted in a kitchen or common area, it gives family members a convenient place to check schedules and manage connected devices.

Price: $349.99  
 Where to Buy: Amazon

The second-generation model includes Fire TV functionality, allowing users to stream entertainment or follow video recipes. A 13MP camera supports video calls, while a physical camera cover provides a straightforward privacy control.

Compared with Apple’s smaller HomeView, the Echo Show 15 emphasizes screen space and shared household organization. Its larger display can be easier to read from across a room, particularly when showing calendars or reminders.
